operation_types: captured Copy/Convert state and source extent
change.ordering: The ring frontend retains the stream across expanded ring batches until guest swap; packet ordinals reset only when the frame is recycled.
change.renderer_contract: Draw references are checked for range, uniqueness, order, and completeness. Existing target-layout, copy-extent, and mixed-sample errors include a bounded ordered-operation description.
change.trace: When SHIFT_NATIVE_VULKAN_TRACE_RING=1, the frontend logs each distinct operation sequence once per worker session.

verified: The target-layout diagnostic preserves copy destination, extent, format/number format, endian, exponent bias, sample select, clear flags, and channel swap.
Reordered draw references are rejected before Vulkan submission.

redmi_note_8_pro.screen: Readable safety disclaimer, unchanged at the latest read-only capture; no input was sent.

limits: The operation stream is capture, validation, and diagnostics plumbing. It does not execute intermediate Copy/Convert operations or preserve ordered Xenos EDRAM targets.
No new on-device rendering or video result is claimed; the current Redmi process was left running on the previously installed build.
